results.derivation: CP grows by D_att +2, subsidy +5, H_END +2, H_CLOSE +3 = 189-byte body, 191 encoded; M_0 4·43 = 172 -> 174; payload 1+4+191+33+174+33 = 436; total 439. g_ts/target_g/M_0/roots are placeholders (DG-V3-1); RecvFit depends only on the listed widths and lengths.
256 + 43·1100 = 47556 > 47104; worst 2·47556+4096 = 99208 > 98304. M_max set to 1100 (same 3-byte width) so the fixture does not also violate R12, which is a ParamGate rule outside validate.
256 + 43·1089 = 47083 <= 47104 (largest n that fits with the GSV1 CP)
subsidy 2^184 encodes in 25 bytes (was 4): +21 -> 47104 exactly; CP body 198 keeps a 2-byte header; worst 2·47104+4096 = 98304 = limit -> accept
2048 + 70k <= 167936 -> k <= 2369 (165888/70 = 2369.83); largest BODY_MAX with floor(B/85) = 2369 is 2369·85+84 = 201449; worst 167878. Equality is unreachable (step 70).

results.text: The network profile genesisPre is not literal in the source: g_ts, target_g, the four HELD M_0 identities, alloc (allocRoot) and sysCodeHash are absent. RF1 uses network CP values with placeholders; its decision depends only on field widths and |genesisPre| (439 B).

end/full allocRoot and sysCodeHash need node-side alloc and system code; placeholders used. w..z come from TK-1 (0.5 proposal); the well-known addresses are an author recollection to be confirmed by an independent root oracle.
H_GSV1 must be agreed by three Keccak libraries after K1-K3 (validation.md:75 iii). Only the accepted pure-Python Keccak runs here: H_GSV1 is recorded, not certified.
The decode error name for the first stage (structure) is not given; this model reports gsStructure (P-V3-2).

consensus.md:27 puts field relations in ParamGate, yet gamma_bp <= 10^4 - alpha_bp is written in the CP field list and |M_0List| bounds in the M_0List rules. Model: gamma relation and |M_0List| >= 1 at decode; M_min/M_max bounds left to ParamGate (R12). Proposal P-V3-3.
networks.json fetch: response cap, deadline and pool reservation semantics are not specified; fixtures use proposals P-V3-6/P-V3-7 (1048576 B, 10000 ms inclusive, reserve recvLimit from TRUST_POOL).

forkSchedule (R24 b-d) is not among the acceptance steps of browser.md:11-16; validate checks its JSON shape only. Step 3 "chainId match" is read as profile.chainId = GenesisSpec.chainId; the endpoint chainId is the netKey check at open (browser.md:19).
No string/URL rules are given for profile fields; validate rejects non-canonical hex and wrong types without normalizing (P-V3-1); endpoint URL syntax is not validated.
implementation.md:292 says NetworkProfiles.validate imports asert and the M3-TS model; no acceptance step uses ASERT. This model does not evaluate ASERT; the dependency is recorded, not faked.
Identity line format "<name> · chainId <n> · genesisHash <full 0x hash>" is a proposal for the step-4 confirmation (the source requires the full hash only).
A validated profile never starts a node in this model: node start needs node-side R24(a) on alloc; GSV1 is additionally on a known-non-bootable list.
Model only: no TypeScript/Chrome options page, no Rust decoder, no real HttpTransport, no signed networks.json signature scheme (signature verification is an input flag).
